messages:
tess: Heads-up: partner pen-test next week. Two special requests from Legal: (1) ensure PII is redacted in artifact bag, (2) provide chain-of-custody notes for evidence handoff. Need owners.

omar: Dates and scope? staging only?

tess: 2026-05-05 09:00 -> 2026-05-06 17:00 UTC. Staging + integration cluster. Includes S3 objects, auth flows, KMS sign-only ops. No prod.

vikram: On PII redaction: we can run a sanitizer pass over audit exports to strip/replace candidate fields (emails, user_ids, ip addresses) and produce a mapping file `meta/pii_map.redacted` with sha256 of original values for audit. Legal okay with hashing originals?

legal-liaison: Hashing originals is acceptable provided we log the process and store the mapping in a locked, short-lived vault accessible only to sec-lead + legal for the retention window. Mapping must be encrypted and listed in manifest.

infra-oncall: I'll provision the escrow S3 path `s3://pt-escrow/partner-20260505/` and create presigned GET URL (7 days). Will also enable object-level server-side encryption and restrict list perms. Placeholder URL: `https://presigned.redwood/pt/partner-20260505`

omar: Chain-of-custody: propose `meta/coc.txt` listing export tooling version, operator, timestamp, export_command, checksums, and GPG sig of manifest. Also include `meta/transfer_audit.log` with presigned URL creation, who uploaded, and who verified.

vikram: Sanitization flow proposal: 1) run export (cloudtrail + internal audit) -> 2) run `sanitize-pii --rules common --out sanitized/` (produces sanitized files + pii_map.redacted.enc) -> 3) generate manifest.csv with per-file sha512 -> 4) sign manifest with offline key -> 5) upload to escrow. We'll include `meta/sanitize_report.txt` with counts of redactions.

legal-liaison: Need a short blurb in manifest top-level `meta/legal_notice.txt` stating what was redacted and why, and point to how to request mapping for forensic needs (ticket + dual approval).

tess: Good. For KMS/HSM: no decrypts. If assessors request decrypted material for reproduction, they must submit a request and we will either provide a controlled verification response via `kms-proxy:verify` or grant temporary decrypt via legal-approved exception (rare).

infra-oncall: Ephemeral OKTA roles for assessors: TTL 3h, scope `staging:read,kms-proxy:sign`. Command: `./grant-temp-role --principal assessor:partner --scopes staging:read,kms-proxy:sign --ttl 3h`. I'll log all grants to `meta/role_grants.log`.

omar: For retest gating: Critical/P0-P1 block retest until fixed & verified; High/P2 require mitigation + test plan; Medium/Low scheduled. Add extra rule: any finding that required redaction re-eval must include `repro_steps.md` with sanitized steps for retest.

vikram: We'll add `meta/sanitizer_rules.yml` to the bag so assessors know which fields were redacted and regex rules used. Also include `meta/sanitize_test_sample/` with before/after anonymized examples (no real PII).

legal-liaison: Also require `meta/consent_record.txt` documenting stakeholder approvals for redaction and retention period (set to 120 days unless partner requests otherwise).

tess: Owners: tess -> overall coord + triage; infra-oncall -> escrow + presigned path + role grants; vikram -> sanitization scripts + sanitizer report; omar -> packaging + manifest + chain-of-custody. Legal-liaison -> legal_notice + mapping governance.

engsec-bot: calendar created: "Partner Pen Test - PII-safe Handoff" 2026-05-05 09:00 -> 2026-05-06 17:00 UTC. Reminder set.

infra-oncall: Dry-run proposed tomorrow 09:00 UTC: test presigned upload, sanitizer run on sample exports, manifest generation & GPG sign, role grant flow.

vikram: I'll prepare a small sample sanitized bag (no real PII) and upload to sample path for review before dry-run.

omar: I'll draft `meta/coc.txt` and `meta/verify.md` with verification steps for assessors.

legal-liaison: One more: record legal hold triggers in `meta/legal_hold_triggers.txt` in case the partner requests extended retention due to an ongoing investigation.

tess: Thanks everyone. Dry-run tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Please post runbook & sample links in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
